description: Record whether the human is an AMC A-List member. member: true needs their own weeklyLimit (films per film week) and advanceLimit (upcoming advance tickets); the planner plans against them as planned capacity, never live AMC eligibility, and a full film week marks showings unbookable. member: false means no weekly A-List capacity is planned: limits are not shown or enforced, and showings are never marked full. null clears the answer: no limit is applied and no showing is held back for one until the human answers again (saved limits are kept). An owner who has never answered keeps whatever limits they had saved applying as planned, without being called a member, if they were stored before this tool existed; a newly created owner has none. get_capacity says which (aList: member, not-member, unconfirmed or unanswered; limited). Ask the human; never assume membership or limits. Never books or touches tickets.
name: set_a_list
title: Set A-List membership and planned limits
